review: Exactly six claimed paths. Reuses encrypted journal validation/CAS, existing explicit recover retry and existing UI work/account locks; no new lifecycle, transport or retry framework.

inspectRequest authenticates existing saved intent and returns detached data, no send authority. Immutable review binding includes version/sender/to/chain/nonce/data/value/expected/startBlock/startHash; only search cursor/discovered hash may change.

prepareSaved validates exact confirmed L2 exit, original recipient, collateral/Bok kind/amount and Bok exit nonce/scope; reconcile-only first. Canonical success returns without send; reverted/replaced or wrong identity rejects.

Explicit review plus separate confirm retains original sender nonce/calldata/value/chain. Normal prepare and Check existing refund remain fenced/read-only. Null tx hash is never interpreted as no broadcast.

Confirmation consumes quote, rereads current exit/wallet/membership, checks saved journal before recover and again inside signer after fresh fee/membership checks. Sender request fields match the reviewed immutable request. Current gas ceiling and account-lock/context/drain behavior remain.
UI states request may still be pending, allows cancel, exposes separate saved-confirm control; does not claim exact signed bytes when wallet may sign a new same-nonce transaction.

Tests cover collateral/Bok continuation, canonical winner at review/confirm, changed wallet/chain/leaf/gas/settlement/context/cancel/amount/recipient/exit, authenticated journal replacement before/inside signer, hidden pending nonce and interrupted retry.
